channel.desc: Amanda Holden hosts this exciting night quiz show, packed with strategy, high stakes and lots of surprises. Five contestants choose a celebrity partner and are assigned a secret stash of cash worth up to a whopping ?6,000. The celebrities helping the contestants are Scarlette Douglas, Josh Jones, Sanjeev Kohli, Joe Baggs and Luca Bish.
